environment.description: Same Django REST API deployed on EKS behind an internal NLB (scheme: internal). The NLB target group is associated with a VPC endpoint service. Consumers connect via PrivateLink interface endpoints provisioned only in approved accounts. The NLB listener has no public IP and resides in private subnets (10.0.64.0/19, 10.0.96.0/19). VPC endpoint service has 'Acceptance Required' enabled and the allowed-principals list is restricted to arn:aws:iam::111111111111:root and arn:aws:iam::222222222222:root (the NOC and SRE team accounts). DNS is private-hosted-zone only (diagnostics.internal.corp.net). Additionally, the EKS pod runs with a NetworkPolicy allowing ingress only from the NLB health-check CIDR and the pod CIDR of the ingress-controller namespace. There is no internet-facing ingress path; the VPC has no IGW attached to the private subnets hosting the NLB.

config.dns: private hosted zone only (no public resolution)
config.authentication: Cognito JWT (private user pool, no public signup, SAML federation from corporate IdP only)
